title: Following instructions
examples: Can you show me what it means to listen carefully?
What is the difference between one instruction and two instructions?
What should I do if I forget what you just said?

explain.say: An instruction tells you what to do. Listen to this one. Touch your nose.
That was one instruction. You did one thing.
Now listen to two steps. Clap your hands, then stamp your feet.
You did two things in order. First you clapped. Then you stamped.

draw.text: First, then: two things in order.

explain.say: If you forget a step, that is okay. Ask, Can you say it again, please?

draw.text: Can you say it again, please?

faq.q: What if I only do the first thing you say?
faq.a: That is okay. Ask the grown-up to say it again. Then do both steps.
asks: What if I stop after the first action?
Do I have to do everything you say?

faq.q: Is listening the same as hearing?
faq.a: Hearing is when sound comes to your ears. Listening means you pay attention to the words.
asks: What is the difference between hearing and listening?
Do I just need to hear you talk?

faq.q: Do I have to do the steps in order?
faq.a: Yes, the order matters. You do the first thing, and then you do the second thing.
asks: Can I do the second thing first?
Does the order matter when I follow directions?

faq.q: What should I do if I get confused?
faq.a: It is okay to feel confused. You can look at me or ask me to say it again slowly.
asks: What if I forget what you said?
Can you repeat the instructions if I get mixed up?

faq.q: Are two steps always harder than one step?
faq.a: Two steps can feel harder at first. With practice, they get easier.
asks: Is two steps always more work?
Will I get better at following steps?

facts: Listening means paying attention to what someone says.
One-step instructions ask you to do only one thing.
Two-step instructions ask you to do two things in order.
When we listen, we use our ears and our brains.

quiz.say: Listen. Clap your hands, then sit down. Tap how many steps.
quiz.why: Clapping is one step. Sitting down is the next step.

wrong.0: Listen again, because there is one more step after the clap.
wrong.2: Listen again: there is a clap and then sitting down.

quiz.say: Listen. Wash your hands, then have lunch. Tap the first step.
quiz.why: Washing your hands comes first. You use soap to wash your hands.

wrong.1: Lunch is the second step, after washing your hands.
wrong.2: Bed is a different part of the day.

quiz.say: Listen. Take a breath, then wiggle your fingers. Tap the second step.
quiz.why: The second step is to wiggle your fingers. Your fingers are on your hands.

wrong.0: The breath through your nose is the first step.
wrong.2: Feet are a different part of your body from the instruction.
